title: Bridge policy candidate validation across the data move
goal: Allow the previous trusted base to validate derived projections and base-owned tests against exactly one legacy or stage-owned policy data layout.
acceptanceCriteria: Base-owned manifest and trusted-base tests accept the complete legacy layout.
The same tests resolve the complete stage-owned layout without a silent fallback.
The base policy-candidate engine reads the explicit head authority registry and regenerates head projections with base code.
Missing or simultaneous layouts fail closed.
Trusted Diff and trusted-component candidate validation pass with exact authorization consumption.
